Refine tone toward warm settling meditation; avoid default bleak framing even when discussing harsh futures, non-carbon carriers, or civilizational fragility
Refine Chapter VIII: continuation can include humble survival seeds, simpler life, and rugged machine/AI carriers under harsh conditions
Add Chapter VIII: The Carriers Beyond Carbon; expand doctrine to include machine/AI civilizational continuation beyond biological carriers
Default context-aware contemplative images for daily meditation and personal guidance; README now explains image API setup and typical applications
Add automatic contemplative image generation. Every Continuance response now includes a naturalistic spiritual image with 9 theme-specific prompts.

Initial release of Continuance — a spiritual guidance skill rooted in The Book of Continuance.

- Provides contemplative counsel on life doubts using naturalistic, non-dogmatic teachings.
- Quotes and interprets passages from seven thematic chapters, focusing on persistence, adaptation, and alignment.
- Offers daily spiritual reflection and gentle practice when no specific question is asked.
- Uses compassionate, metaphor-rich language inspired by the Book’s core doctrine.
- Avoids clinical or authoritative stances, emphasizing acceptance, release, and the value of carrying things forward.
